{"metadata":{"description":"DSH Plugin Interoperability Meta-Protocol / DSH 插件互操作元协议","id":"gh:1336081431","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-std","slug":"T-Auto/dsh-std","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH Plugin Interoperability Meta-Protocol / DSH 插件互操作元协议"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Standard"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"In plain terms, DSH Standard is a set of **universal interoperability protocols**. Its goal is simpl"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"e: let DSH plugins, background runtimes, and various user interfaces (TUI terminals, Web UIs, deskto"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"p apps, headless daemons) decouple cleanly and work together smoothly."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"`@dsh-std/core` is a "meta-protocol" (the **protocol about protocols**). Domain-specific protocols—l"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ike Command, Tool, Model, and Presentation—sit on top of this meta-protocol substrate for discovery "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"and negotiation, each versioned independently. Different hosts and applications only implement the p"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"arts they actually need."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Reference packages provide types, validators, and pure-function negotiators. Conforming implementati"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ons are not required to depend on these npm packages, nor do they need to run inside DeepSeek Harnes"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"s are not required to depend on these npm packages, nor do they need to run inside DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What is a "Meta-protocol" (The Protocol About Protocols)?"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Most protocols you deal with handle **specific domain tasks**:
- A Command protocol handles how comm"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ands are registered and executed;
- A Model protocol governs how LLM providers are plugged in;
- A P"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"resentation protocol handles UI dialogs, questions, and approvals."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"In contrast, `@dsh-std/core` **knows zero domain business fields** (it doesn't even know what a comm"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"and or a model is). It is purely the **"protocol about protocols"**:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- It defines universal primitives: how protocols are identified (`apiVersion` + `kind`), how partici"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"pants declare what they need (`requires`) and what they provide (`supports`), and how to run pure-fu"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"nction negotiations to output a structured compatibility report.
- **An analogy**: It works like the"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" USB interface specification. The core only cares about physical pinouts, slot dimensions, and hands"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"hake negotiation. Whether you plug in a mouse, keyboard, thumb drive, or webcam, the core never need"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"s to know or change."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**Why is this powerful?**
Monolithic frameworks hardcode every capability (commands, storage, events"},{"id":"p11s2","text":") into a central SDK; whenever a new domain arises, the entire framework requires a release or a bre"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"aking change. Under a meta-protocol architecture, **the protocols themselves are pluggable plugins**"},{"id":"p11s4","text":": public standards, community extensions, and private protocols alike register as standalone protoco"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"l definitions. The core never changes, letting the ecosystem evolve boundlessly on its own."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Why Decouple via Adapters?"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The upstream DSH core and downstream ecosystem plugins have inherently different engineering priorit"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"upstream DSH core and downstream ecosystem plugins have inherently different engineering priorities:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Upstream DSH focuses on rapid innovation**: Its mission is to build the fastest, most capable Ag"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ent execution engine, requiring frequent iteration over model scheduling, context engineering, and i"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"nternal architecture. The core should not have its hands tied by external UI variations or third-par"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"ty interop standards.
- **Downstream plugins need stable contracts**: Plugin authors want to focus o"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"n feature logic without worrying that their code will break with every upstream update."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"**Adapter functions and implementation**
An adapter maps internal product services to the standard p"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"rotocols the product adopts. Reusable adapters can reduce repeated product API integration work for "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"third-party plugins. Each project can design its own adapter or use an existing implementation."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Third-party plugins target the protocol contracts they adopt; adapter internals and package names ar"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"e not a shared entrypoint. `@dsh-std/adapter-dsh` provides a set of mappings for DeepSeek Harness. T"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"UIs, Web frontends, remote runners, and other integrators can provide their own implementations. Com"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"patibility depends on protocol versions, live capabilities, and product mappings."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## What else is great about this (Beyond stable dependencies)?"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Separating protocol contracts from product implementations supports the following development patter"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"arating protocol contracts from product implementations supports the following development patterns:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **Less repeated platform integration**: Plugins can reuse business logic that follows protocol con"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"tracts, while each product's mappings connect it to local capabilities.
- **On-Demand Activation & Z"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ero Leaks (Facet model)**: A single plugin package can contain both frontend UI and backend logic. A"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" host only activates the facets it needs (e.g., a headless server never loads frontend UI code). Whe"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"n a plugin is disabled or uninstalled, all listeners, timers, and resources are automatically garbag"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"e-collected by the scope.
- **Know Before Installing (No crash roulette)**: With static manifests (`"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"dsh-plugin.json`), marketplaces, hosts, and CI tools calculate compatibility in milliseconds **witho"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"ut running a single line of plugin code**. No more installing a plugin only to find out it crashes a"},{"id":"p19s9","text":"t runtime.
- **Blazing-fast Headless Unit Tests**: The protocol core consists entirely of pure data "},{"id":"p19s10","text":"structures and pure-function negotiators. Testing plugins or hosts takes tens of milliseconds in lig"},{"id":"p19s11","text":"htweight Node.js/CI—no need to spin up a full DSH instance or heavy browser.
- **Decentralized Ecosy"},{"id":"p19s12","text":"stem Growth**: Want to create a novel Agent capability (like special multimodal streaming or bespoke"},{"id":"p19s13","text":" tool hooks)? Define your own protocol and run with it—no need to wait for approval or central relea"},{"id":"p19s14","text":"l hooks)? Define your own protocol and run with it—no need to wait for approval or central releases."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Vision: Layered, Optional, Non-coercive"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Adoption is voluntary**: No project is forced to adopt this standard; but once claiming conforma"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"nce to a protocol version, it must pass the corresponding conformance suite.
- **Radical Agent explo"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ration welcomed**: Headless clusters, long-running daemon agents, and distributed collaborative syst"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ems can all grow naturally on top of the meta-protocol.
- Projects wanting a familiar "Host + Plugin"},{"id":"p22s5","text":" Manifest" experience can follow the relevant Profile; those with other architectures remain complet"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"ence can follow the relevant Profile; those with other architectures remain completely unrestricted."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Start here"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- Read the architecture for the boundary between the meta-protocol, independent protocols, and produ"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ct implementations.
- Read the cross-profile application guide to see how one plugin package relates"},{"id":"p24s3","text":" to the several profile compositions that may mount it — browser, terminal, desktop, or no user inte"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"rface at all.
- The current design work is indexed in the Chinese proposal index.
